reason: This plugin is primarily a chat productivity utility that automates prompt refinement in DeepSeek Harness: a one-click action (and slash command) rewrites user prompts with structured output, then supports one-click undo. It appears safe and low-to-moderate risk (R1) because it processes user prompt text and can trigger network model calls, but it does not indicate file, shell, or external side-effect operations.

capabilities: Reads user-entered prompt text from chat input
Sends prompt text to model endpoint for enhancement when available
Falls back to built-in rule-based expansion when model is unavailable
Injects an in-chat button and performs one-click text replace/undo in the composer

reasons.code: README describes a `/prompt-enhance` command and default-model-based prompt rewrite flow with automatic rule fallback when LLM times out/unavailable.
README specifies a web chat UI button added to conversation input for one-click expansion and one-click undo of replaced text.
Package metadata declares web client integration and dependencies on DSH API/model remotes, implying runtime communication with model services.
